listing.name: Bakugan: Battle Brawlers — Bakugan PS3 recomp (Mauryln) (Mauryln)
listing.summary: The project reports startup, videos, menus and the start of a duel. 3D graphics are deformed, and tutorial/story gameplay and sound effects fail. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe BLES00758 EBOOT and assets. This guide does not specify the exact supported revision.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s local source translation and build instructions using clang-cl and Ninja.
